# OptimAI Creative Agents: full reference

> Local-first browser AI, creative workflows and a community builder SDK. MIT-licensed JavaScript SDK, version 0.5.0, workspace contract 1.3, 39 reviewed agent templates. Node.js >=20 and modern browsers; no runtime dependencies. This file inlines every public declaration and guide; [llms.txt](llms.txt) is the short map.

How to work with this SDK:

- A recipe is a portable v1 JSON manifest: a reviewed template ID, approved setting values and a creative brief. It never carries code, model URLs or credentials.
- Scaffold with `npm run create`, validate with `node scripts/verify.mjs path/to/agent.json`, and run `npm test` before proposing a change.
- Import the public subpaths below; each module ships a `.d.mts` declaration beside it. Files without a subpath are internal. `npm run mcp` starts the local stdio MCP adapter.
- Optional peers stay optional and pinned: `@mlc-ai/web-llm@0.2.85`, `@mediapipe/tasks-vision@1.1.0`, `three@0.186.1`, `mediabunny@1.62.1`. Canvas, catalog, color, crop, verify and beat modules need none.
- Selected media stays on the device. Media generation, accounts and billing belong to the host application, not this SDK.

## Templates

- Canvas (11): `mockup-maker`, `image-finish`, `reference-blend`, `image-grid`, `print-shop`, `title-frame`, `pixel-layout`, `poster-lab`, `transition-lab`, `glitch-cut`, `letter-pose`
- Browser vision (3): `select-and-replace`, `motion-pose`, `face-performance`
- Writing (5): `cast-notes`, `style-brief`, `storyboard-builder`, `prompt-branches`, `story-seed`
- Interactive (6): `music-reactive`, `frame-sculpture`, `camera-stage`, `model-turntable`, `scene-lighting`, `avatar-stage`
- Guided (14): `sketch-to-scene`, `world-finder`, `shot-atlas`, `motion-finish`, `sketch-to-motion`, `dream-signal`, `frame-fit`, `rough-cut`, `rhythm-cut`, `frame-study`, `motion-tracker`, `depth-motion`, `scene-scout`, `scene-remix`

## Building a recipe

<!-- skills/build-a-recipe/SKILL.md -->

### Build a Creative Agents recipe

A recipe is a small JSON file (`agent.json`, manifest v1.0) that names one **reviewed template**, sets some of its **approved settings** and adds a **creative brief**. It is data, not code. Hosts such as OptimAI Studio import it and run the template's own engine.

Run every command from the SDK root (the folder with `package.json` named `@optimai/creative-agents`). Nothing here needs `npm install`, an account, a model or the network.

#### Rules that never bend

- Never add fields. The manifest and `recipe` are closed objects: scripts, URLs, model names, credentials or extra keys fail validation.
- `capabilities` is always exactly `{ "network": "none", "execution": "declarative", "dataAccess": "selected-inputs" }` and `license` is always `"MIT"`.
- `recipe.templateId` must be one of the reviewed template IDs. You cannot invent a template in a recipe; a new engine is a code contribution (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`).
- `recipe.values` may only hold settings the chosen template declares, with values inside their bounds. Omitted settings use the template default, so set only what the creator asked for.
- `category` must equal the template's category. Copy it from the scaffold; do not guess it.
- Do not put personal data, secrets or private file paths in `title`, `description` or `brief`. Recipes are shared.
- Do not publish, push or upload anything. The commands below only write local files.

#### Steps

##### 1. Choose a template

List every template with what it really does:

```sh
npm run verify
```

Each line is `id: capability`. The capability tells the creator what to expect: *browser* templates produce a result on the device, *local-model* templates write text with a model the creator installs, and *studio-guided* templates prepare a prompt for a host to produce. Say which kind you picked; never describe a studio-guided template as generating media by itself. The grouped list is in `docs/catalog.md`.

##### 2. Read the template's settings

```sh
node --input-type=module -e 'import { getAgentFormSchema } from "./src/form-schema.mjs"; console.log(JSON.stringify(getAgentFormSchema("poster-lab").properties, null, 2));'
```

This prints JSON Schema for `recipe.values`: each setting's type, `enum` options, `minimum`/`maximum`, `pattern` and `default`. Use only these keys and values. Numbers are JSON numbers, not strings. Colors are `#rgb` or `#rrggbb`.

##### 3. Scaffold

```sh
npm run create -- sunrise-poster --template poster-lab
```

This writes `agents/sunrise-poster/agent.json` and a README, and refuses to overwrite an existing folder. The ID is a lowercase slug (`^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`, at most 64 characters) and must match the `id` in the file.

##### 4. Edit the manifest

Change only `title` (1–80 characters), `description` (1–600), `recipe.values` and `recipe.brief` (at most 4,000 characters). Keep `version` as plain `x.y.z`. A finished recipe looks like this:

```json
{
  "schemaVersion": "1.0",
  "id": "sunrise-poster",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "title": "Sunrise Poster",
  "description": "A tall cinema-style poster with a warm headline for a morning event.",
  "category": "video",
  "license": "MIT",
  "capabilities": {
    "network": "none",
    "execution": "declarative",
    "dataAccess": "selected-inputs"
  },
  "recipe": {
    "templateId": "poster-lab",
    "values": {
      "title": "Rise early",
      "ratio": "9:16",
      "treatment": "cinema",
      "color": "#ffd38a"
    },
    "brief": "Warm first light over a quiet city. Keep the headline short and leave room around it."
  }
}
```

The brief is creative direction in plain language: subject, mood, what to keep, what to avoid. Do not restate the settings in it.

##### 5. Validate

```sh
node scripts/verify.mjs agents/sunrise-poster/agent.json
```

Success prints `Validated sunrise-poster (poster-lab).` On failure every line names the path and the fix, for example `recipe.values.treatment: choose editorial, cinema, minimal.` or `recipe.values.nope: this template has no such setting.` Fix exactly what is named and run it again. Do not loosen the manifest to make an error go away, and never report a recipe as done before this command passes.

##### 6. Prepare the prompt (optional)

```sh
node --input-type=module -e 'import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises"; import { validateAgentManifest, compileAgentPrompt } from "./src/index.mjs"; const result = validateAgentManifest(JSON.parse(await readFile("agents/sunrise-poster/agent.json", "utf8"))); if (!result.success) throw new Error(result.errors.join("\n")); console.log(compileAgentPrompt(result.manifest));'
```

This prints the text a host would receive. It calls no model and makes no image or video.

##### 7. Hand over

Tell the creator the file path, the template and its capability kind, which settings you changed from the defaults, and that validation passed. They can import `agent.json` into a host's saved recipes or share the file.

#### Working in code instead of files

```js
import { createAgentManifest, validateAgentManifest } from '@optimai/creative-agents';

const recipe = createAgentManifest('poster-lab', { id: 'sunrise-poster', title: 'Sunrise Poster', brief: 'Warm first light over a quiet city.' });
recipe.recipe.values = { ratio: '9:16', treatment: 'cinema' };
const result = validateAgentManifest(recipe);
if (!result.success) throw new Error(result.errors.join('\n'));
```

`createAgentManifest` fills the category, license and capabilities for you. Every public module has a `.d.mts` declaration; `llms.txt` maps them and `llms-full.txt` inlines them. If you change SDK code or declarations rather than a recipe, run `npm test` and `npm run typecheck`.

#### When the request does not fit

- **A setting the template lacks:** say so, and put the wish in the brief if it is creative direction. Do not add the key.
- **A template that does not exist:** offer the closest reviewed template from `npm run verify`.
- **Running the recipe:** canvas, vision, camera, 3D and music templates run in a browser (`examples/playground/`); writing templates need a local model (`npm run run -- --help`). Neither is part of building the recipe.

## Declarations

### `@optimai/creative-agents`

Declared in `src/index.d.mts`, implemented in `src/index.mjs`.

```ts
export type ToolCategory = 'image' | 'video' | 'writing' | 'experimental';
export type StudioMode = 'image' | 'video' | 'story' | 'character' | 'editor';
export type LocalOperation = 'image-filter' | 'image-resize' | 'image-grid' | 'type-overlay' | 'prompt-builder';
export type RecipeValues = Record<string, string | number>;
export type AgentCategory = ToolCategory;
export type AgentExecutionKind = 'browser' | 'browser-interactive' | 'local-model' | 'studio-guided';
export type CanvasLabOperation = 'mockup' | 'poster' | 'bento' | 'glitch' | 'letter' | 'blend' | 'transition' | 'print';
export type AgentWorkspace = (
  | { readonly kind: 'canvas'; readonly operation: Exclude<LocalOperation, 'prompt-builder'> | CanvasLabOperation }
  | { readonly kind: 'vision'; readonly operation: 'person-cutout' | 'pose-reference' | 'face-reference' }
  | { readonly kind: 'writing'; readonly operation: 'cast-notes' | 'style-brief' | 'storyboard-builder' | 'prompt-branches' | 'story-seed' }
  | { readonly kind: 'sketch'; readonly operation: 'draw' }
  | { readonly kind: '3d'; readonly operation: 'scene' }
  | { readonly kind: 'camera'; readonly operation: 'effects' | 'avatar' }
  | { readonly kind: 'music'; readonly operation: 'reactive' }
  | { readonly kind: 'frame'; readonly operation: 'sculpture' }
  | { readonly kind: 'workflow' }
) & { readonly headline?: string };
export interface ToolField {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly label: string;
  readonly type: 'text' | 'textarea' | 'select' | 'number';
  readonly default: string | number;
  readonly options?: readonly string[];
  readonly min?: number;
  readonly max?: number;
}
export interface ToolTemplate {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly title: string;
  readonly description: string;
  readonly sourceTemplate: string;
  readonly category: ToolCategory;
  readonly icon: string;
  readonly accent: string;
  readonly runtime: 'local' | 'studio';
  readonly localOperation?: LocalOperation;
  readonly studioMode: StudioMode;
  readonly promptTemplate: string;
  readonly fields: readonly ToolField[];
  readonly tags: readonly string[];
  readonly executionKind: AgentExecutionKind;
  readonly workspace: AgentWorkspace;
}
export interface ToolManifest {
  schemaVersion: '1.0';
  id: string;
  version: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  category: ToolCategory;
  license: 'MIT';
  capabilities: { network: 'none'; execution: 'declarative'; dataAccess: 'selected-inputs' };
  recipe: { templateId: string; values: RecipeValues; brief: string };
}
export type ManifestValidation = { success: true; manifest: ToolManifest; errors: string[] } | { success: false; manifest?: undefined; errors: string[] };
export type AgentField = ToolField;
export type AgentTemplate = ToolTemplate;
export type AgentManifest = ToolManifest;
export type AgentManifestValidation = ManifestValidation;
export declare const MANIFEST_VERSION: '1.0';
export declare const AGENT_WORKSPACE_CONTRACT_VERSION: '1.3';
export declare const MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH: number;
export declare const TOOL_CATALOG: readonly ToolTemplate[];
export declare const AGENT_CATALOG: readonly AgentTemplate[];
export declare const TOOL_MANIFEST_SCHEMA: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
export declare const AGENT_MANIFEST_SCHEMA: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
export declare const getAgentTemplate: typeof getToolTemplate;
export declare const getAgentExecutionKind: (id: string) => AgentExecutionKind | undefined;
export declare function getAgentWorkspace(id: string): AgentWorkspace | undefined;
export declare function validateAgentWorkspace(workspace: unknown): string[];
export type AgentInputNeed = 'canvas' | 'webgl' | 'webgpu' | 'web-audio' | 'worker' | 'wasm' | 'camera' | 'pointer' | 'media-recorder' | 'offscreen-canvas';
export interface AgentInputPolicy {
  readonly minFiles: number;
  readonly maxFiles: number;
  /** Value for an `<input type="file" accept>` attribute; empty when the agent takes no files. */
  readonly accept: string;
  /** Per-file byte cap; 0 when the agent takes no files. */
  readonly maxBytes: number;
  /** Browser features the agent cannot run without. */
  readonly needs: readonly AgentInputNeed[];
  /** Browser features that add tracking, export or faster models when present. */
  readonly optional: readonly AgentInputNeed[];
  /** True when the whole result is produced on the device, without a host production step. */
  readonly onDevice: boolean;
}
export declare const AGENT_INPUT_NEEDS: readonly AgentInputNeed[];
export declare function getAgentInputPolicy(id: string): AgentInputPolicy | undefined;
export declare function getToolTemplate(id: string): ToolTemplate | undefined;
export declare function validateRecipeValues(toolId: string, values: unknown): string[];
/** The JSON Schema a recipe value of this field must satisfy (the same bounds `validateRecipeValues` enforces). */
export declare function recipeFieldSchema(field: ToolField): Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
export declare function validateToolManifest(value: unknown): ManifestValidation;
export declare function createToolManifest(templateId: string, details: { id: string; title: string; description?: string; brief?: string }): ToolManifest;
export declare function compileToolPrompt(toolOrManifest: ToolTemplate | ToolManifest | string, values?: RecipeValues, brief?: string): string;
export declare const validateAgentManifest: typeof validateToolManifest;
export declare const createAgentManifest: typeof createToolManifest;
export declare const compileAgentPrompt: typeof compileToolPrompt;
export declare function verifyRegistry(): { success: boolean; errors: string[]; count: number };
```

### `@optimai/creative-agents/browser-runtime`

Declared in `src/browser-runtime.d.mts`, implemented in `src/browser-runtime.mjs`.

```ts
import type { TextScrim, TitlePlacement } from './text-placement.mjs';
export type LocalToolOperation = 'image-filter' | 'image-resize' | 'image-grid' | 'type-overlay';
export type LocalToolValues = Record<string, string | number>;
export type LocalImageSize = { width: number; height: number };
export type LocalToolOutput = LocalImageSize & { blob: Blob; filename: string; /** Title color actually drawn by type-overlay. */ ink?: string; /** Lines of the title as drawn by type-overlay. */ lines?: string[]; /** Where type-overlay drew the title block. */ placement?: TitlePlacement; /** Scrim type-overlay drew behind the title, or null. */ scrim?: TextScrim | null; /** How image-filter graded: `pixel` (OKLab engine) or the `css` filter fallback. */ colorEngine?: 'pixel' | 'css'; /** Title of the film look or `.cube` LUT image-filter applied. */ lut?: string };

export declare const LOCAL_IMAGE_LIMITS: Readonly<{
    files: 8;
    bytes: number;
    dimension: 4096;
    pixels: 16000000;
}>;

/** A displayable validation message, or null when the declared format and size are accepted. */
export declare function validateLocalImageFile(file: Pick<File, 'name' | 'size' | 'type'>): string | null;

/** Compute the exact output dimensions without reading images or using browser APIs. */
export declare function getToolOutputSize(
    operation: LocalToolOperation,
    dimensions: LocalImageSize | readonly LocalImageSize[],
    values?: LocalToolValues,
): LocalImageSize;

/**
 * Run only a reviewed local operation, returning a downloadable PNG without network access.
 * Cover fits (resize and grid) use focus-aware cropping by default; pass `crop: 'center'` to opt out.
 * image-filter grades per pixel in OKLab (`colorEngine: 'pixel'`, optional `seed` for grain); `colorEngine: 'css'` keeps the legacy filter.
 * After the grade it applies `film` (none, golden, teal-amber or matte) or `lut` (`.cube` text, which wins), both scaled by `intensity`.
 */
export declare function runLocalTool(
    operation: LocalToolOperation,
    files: File[],
    values: LocalToolValues,
    signal?: AbortSignal,
): Promise<LocalToolOutput>;
```

### `@optimai/creative-agents/canvas-lab`

Declared in `src/canvas-lab.d.mts`, implemented in `src/canvas-lab.mjs`.

```ts
import type { ProgressEvent } from './progress.mjs';
import type { TextPosition, TextScrim, TitlePlacement } from './text-placement.mjs';
import type { GlitchEffect } from './glitch.mjs';
import type { PrintLook, RisoInkPair } from './print.mjs';
import type { TransitionDirection, TransitionPace, TransitionStyle } from './transition.mjs';
/** What Transition Lab drew; `requested` is set when a canvas without pixel reads fell back to a dissolve. */
export type DrawnTransition = { style: TransitionStyle; requested?: TransitionStyle; direction: TransitionDirection; pace: TransitionPace; /** Eased progress of the exported frame, 0–1. */ progress: number };
/** The whole move as one PNG of evenly spaced frames; `frames` holds each frame's time in percent. */
export type TransitionStrip = { blob: Blob; width: number; height: number; frames: number[] };
/** What Glitch Cut drew: `pixels` is the full seeded glitch; `bands` the seeded band shifts only, where a canvas cannot read pixels. */
export type DrawnGlitch = { effect: GlitchEffect; seed: number; amount: number; engine: 'pixels' | 'bands' };
/** What Print Shop drew: `inks` for a riso duotone, `ink` for the one-color looks. */
export type DrawnPrint = { look: PrintLook; scale: number; amount: number; seed: number; inks?: [string, string]; ink?: string; paper: string };
export const CANVAS_LAB_AGENTS: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
/** Merge template defaults with explicit recipe values and normalize legacy aliases. */
export function canvasLabRecipeSettings(templateId: string, values?: Record<string, string | number>): ReturnType<typeof canvasLabSettings>;
/** Engine settings (a run record's, say) back to v1 recipe `values`, plus engine-only `extra` settings that differ from the template defaults. */
export function canvasLabRecipeValues(templateId: string, settings?: Record<string, unknown>): { values: Record<string, string | number>; extra: Record<string, string | number> };
export function canvasLabSettings(operation: string, values?: Record<string, string | number>): { operation: string; title: string; color: string; layout: string; ratio: string; treatment: string; amount: number; mix: number; crop: 'smart' | 'center'; ink: 'readable' | 'image' | 'exact'; position: TextPosition; scrim: 'auto' | 'off'; transition: TransitionStyle; direction: TransitionDirection; pace: TransitionPace; effect: GlitchEffect; seed: number; look: PrintLook; inks: RisoInkPair; scale: number; frames: number };
/** The fourth argument is an AbortSignal or `{ signal, onProgress }`; progress stages are prepare → render → frame (transition strip) → export → ready. */
export function runCanvasLab(operation: string, files?: File[], values?: Record<string, string | number>, options?: AbortSignal | { signal?: AbortSignal; onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void }): Promise<{blob: Blob; width: number; height: number; filename: string; /** Title color actually drawn (poster and letter). */ ink?: string; /** Title lines as drawn (poster and letter). */ lines?: string[]; /** Where the title block was drawn (poster and letter). */ placement?: TitlePlacement; /** Scrim drawn behind the title, or null (poster and letter). */ scrim?: TextScrim | null; /** Transition drawn (transition only). */ transition?: DrawnTransition; /** Preview strip, or null when `frames` is 0 or pixels cannot be read (transition only). */ strip?: TransitionStrip | null; /** Glitch drawn, with the seed that reproduces it (glitch only). */ glitch?: DrawnGlitch; /** Print drawn, with the seed that reproduces its grain (print only). */ print?: DrawnPrint}>;
/** A Transition Lab clip ready for frame-by-frame export. */
export type TransitionClip = Readonly<{
  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement; width: number; height: number; seconds: number;
  /** Style drawn; `dissolve` when the canvas cannot read pixels. */
  style: TransitionStyle; direction: TransitionDirection; pace: TransitionPace;
  /** Draw frame `index` of a `frames`-long clip (frame 0 is the first shot, the last frame the second). */
  draw(index: number, frames: number): void;
  /** Release the images and the canvas. */
  close(): void;
}>;
/** Open two shots with Transition Lab's crop and style and return a clip to render with `exportCanvasVideo`. */
export function createTransitionClip(files: File[], values?: Record<string, string | number>, options?: { width?: number; seconds?: number; hold?: number; signal?: AbortSignal; onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void }): Promise<TransitionClip>;
```

### `@optimai/creative-agents/agent-runtime`

Declared in `src/agent-runtime.d.mts`, implemented in `src/agent-runtime.mjs`.

```ts
export type WritingAgentId = 'cast-notes' | 'style-brief' | 'storyboard-builder' | 'prompt-branches' | 'story-seed';
export type AgentErrorCode = 'unavailable' | 'model-missing' | 'invalid-response' | 'timeout' | 'unsafe-endpoint' | 'invalid-model' | 'invalid-input';
export declare class AgentRuntimeError extends Error { readonly code: AgentErrorCode; constructor(code: AgentErrorCode, message: string); }
export declare const LOCAL_AGENT_LIMITS: Readonly<{
    statusTimeoutMs: 4000; metadataTimeoutMs: 8000; generationTimeoutMs: 90000; responseBytes: 262144;
    modelBytes: number; contextTokens: 8192; outputTokens: 4096;
}>;
export type AgentProgress = { stage: 'plan' | 'generate' | 'validate' | 'repair'; message: string; attempt: 1 | 2 };
export type LocalModel = { name: string; size: number; family: string; parameterSize: string };
export type LocalModelStatus = {
    provider: 'ollama'; available: boolean; baseUrl: string; models: LocalModel[];
    suggestedModel: string | null; version: string | null;
    reason?: 'unavailable' | 'no-models' | 'invalid-response' | 'timeout'; message?: string;
};
/** baseUrl overrides Node host configuration OPTIMAI_OLLAMA_URL; only literal loopback HTTP is accepted. */
export type LocalAgentOptions = { signal?: AbortSignal; fetchImpl?: typeof fetch; baseUrl?: string };
export type CreativeAgentResult = {
    title: string; summary: string; sections: { heading: string; body: string }[]; studioPrompt: string;
    model: string; provider: 'ollama' | 'webllm'; templateId: WritingAgentId; attempts: 1 | 2;
};
export type PreparedCreativeAgentTask = Readonly<{
    templateId: WritingAgentId; title: string; sectionCount: number; budget: number;
    schema: Record<string, unknown>; instructions: string; maxOutputTokens: number;
    messages: { role: 'system' | 'user'; content: string }[];
}>;
export type CreativeAgentArtifact = Pick<CreativeAgentResult, 'title' | 'summary' | 'sections' | 'studioPrompt'>;
/** Pure task contract; retain this task object when validating model output. */
export declare function prepareCreativeAgentTask(options: { templateId: WritingAgentId; values?: Record<string, string | number>; brief?: string }): PreparedCreativeAgentTask;
export declare function validateCreativeAgentOutput(task: PreparedCreativeAgentTask, content: string): { success: true; artifact: CreativeAgentArtifact } | { success: false; errors: string[] };
export declare function getLocalModelStatus(options?: LocalAgentOptions): Promise<LocalModelStatus>;
export declare function runCreativeAgent(options: LocalAgentOptions & {
    templateId: WritingAgentId; values?: Record<string, string | number>; brief?: string;
    model: string; onProgress?: (progress: AgentProgress) => void;
}): Promise<CreativeAgentResult>;
```

### `@optimai/creative-agents/browser-writing-runtime`

```ts
import type { AppConfig, MLCEngineInterface, MLCEngineConfig } from '@mlc-ai/web-llm';
import type { CreativeAgentResult, WritingAgentId } from './agent-runtime.mjs';

export declare const BROWSER_AGENT_MODEL: Readonly<{
  id: 'Qwen3.5-0.8B-q4f16_1-MLC'; title: 'Qwen 3.5 · 0.8B'; license: 'Apache-2.0';
  downloadBytes: 453205372; gpuMemoryMB: 1629.49;
  modelRevision: '0ec138972555613c1d7812a821778ad0398c8790';
  libraryRevision: '025bcaf3780fa8254f5e5efd3bfea0a5397248f4'; contextTokens: 4096;
}>;
export declare const BROWSER_AGENT_APP_CONFIG: AppConfig;
export type BrowserAgentProgress = {
  stage: 'download' | 'ready' | 'plan' | 'generate' | 'validate' | 'repair';
  message: string; progress?: number; attempt?: 1 | 2;
  /** Reviewed download size in bytes, on `download` events. */ total?: number;
};
export type BrowserAgentStatus = {
  provider: 'webllm'; available: boolean; ready: boolean; loading: boolean;
  model: typeof BROWSER_AGENT_MODEL;
  reason?: 'insecure-context' | 'webgpu-unavailable' | 'gpu-limits' | 'worker-unavailable'; message?: string;
};
export type BrowserAgentOptions = { signal?: AbortSignal; onProgress?: (progress: BrowserAgentProgress) => void };
export declare class BrowserAgentError extends Error {

  constructor(code: BrowserAgentError['code'], message: string);
}
export type BrowserWritingRuntime = {
  status(): Promise<BrowserAgentStatus>;
  load(options?: BrowserAgentOptions): Promise<void>;
  run(options: BrowserAgentOptions & { templateId: WritingAgentId; values?: Record<string, string | number>; brief?: string }): Promise<CreativeAgentResult>;
  cancel(): void; unload(): void;
};
export type BrowserWritingEngineSession = { engine: MLCEngineInterface; worker: Worker; failure: Promise<never> };
/** Tests/embedding may inject local engine lifecycle, but task/model contracts remain fixed. */
export declare function createBrowserWritingRuntime(dependencies: {
  support(): Promise<Omit<BrowserAgentStatus, 'ready' | 'loading'>>;
  createSession(onProgress: (progress: BrowserAgentProgress) => void): Promise<BrowserWritingEngineSession>;
  downloadTimeoutMs?: number; generationTimeoutMs?: number;
}): BrowserWritingRuntime;
/** No model is downloaded during capability checks. */
export declare function browserSupport(): Promise<Omit<BrowserAgentStatus, 'ready' | 'loading'>>;
/** Factories refer only to locally bundled engine and worker code in the embedding app. */
export declare function createBrowserAgentRuntime(options: {
  createWorker: () => Worker;
  loadEngine: () => Promise<{ WebWorkerMLCEngine: new (worker: Worker, config: MLCEngineConfig) => MLCEngineInterface }>;
```

### `@optimai/creative-agents/vision-runtime`

Declared in `src/vision-runtime.d.mts`, implemented in `src/vision-runtime.mjs`.

```ts
export type VisionOperation = 'person-cutout' | 'pose-reference' | 'face-reference';
/** A canonical progress event (`stage`, see `progress.d.mts`) that keeps the legacy `phase`; downloads carry `loaded`/`total` bytes. */
export type VisionProgress = { stage: 'download' | 'verify' | 'ready' | 'prepare' | 'warmup' | 'analyze' | 'render'; /** @deprecated Use `stage` (`initialize` is now `warmup`). */ phase: 'download' | 'verify' | 'ready' | 'prepare' | 'initialize' | 'analyze' | 'render'; message: string; progress?: number; loaded?: number; total?: number };
export type VisionModel = { readonly id: string; readonly name: string; readonly bytes: number; readonly sha256: string; readonly url: string; readonly task: string };
export type VisionModelStatus = { operation: VisionOperation; model: VisionModel; ready: boolean; storage: string | null };
```

```ts
import type { OfflineAudioSource } from './offline-analyser.mjs';
export type MusicReactiveLook = 'orbital' | 'ribbons' | 'spectrum' | 'aurora';
export const MUSIC_REACTIVE_LOOKS: readonly Readonly<{ id: MusicReactiveLook; title: string; description: string }>[];
export const MUSIC_REACTIVE_LIMITS: Readonly<{ bands: 48; maxFrequencyBins: 16384; maxDimension: 4096; maxPixels: 8388608 }>;
/** Normalized analyser display signals; these are not loudness, BPM or beats. */
export interface MusicReactiveFeatures { energy: number; bass: number; treble: number; bands: number[] }
/** Supply the actual sample rate / FFT size even when the frequency buffer is shortened. */
export function extractMusicReactiveFeatures(frequencyBytes: Uint8Array, options?: { sampleRate?: number; fftSize?: number }): MusicReactiveFeatures;
/** Elapsed-time attack/release smoothing; null previous resets after a seek/source change. */
export function smoothMusicReactiveFeatures(previous: MusicReactiveFeatures | null, target: Partial<MusicReactiveFeatures>, elapsedMs: number, options?: { attackMs?: number; releaseMs?: number }): MusicReactiveFeatures;
export interface MusicReactiveFrame {
  width: number; height: number;
  /** Audio playback position in seconds. */
  time: number;
  energy: number; bass: number; treble: number;
  look: MusicReactiveLook | string;
  /** Normalized 0–1. */
  intensity: number;
  title?: string; artist?: string;
  /** Freezes motion and audio-driven geometry for a stable cover frame. */
  reducedMotion?: boolean;
  /** Optional 48 measured logarithmic frequency bands. */
  bands?: readonly number[];
  /** Beat pulse 0–1 (see beat-tracker). Swells geometry only; ignored with reducedMotion. */
  pulse?: number;
}
/** Draws a bounded frame and restores caller canvas state. No network or timers. */
export function renderMusicReactiveFrame(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D | OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D, options: MusicReactiveFrame): void;
export type MusicReactiveRendererOptions = Partial<Omit<MusicReactiveFrame, 'time' | 'energy' | 'bass' | 'treble' | 'bands' | 'pulse'>> & {
  /** Video frame rate, above 0 and at most 120. Default 30. */
  fps?: number;
  /** Analyser FFT size. Default 2048, like the live preview. */
  fftSize?: number;
  /** Flash-limited beat pulse, as in playback. Default true. */
  beatSync?: boolean;
};
export type MusicReactiveRenderer = Readonly<{
  /** Song length in seconds. */ duration: number; fps: number; sampleRate: number;
  /** Frames that cover the song at `fps`. */ frames: number;
  /** Draw frame `index` (in order) onto `ctx`, as the live preview would have shown it at `index / fps`. */
  draw(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D | OffscreenCanvasRenderingContext2D, index: number): void;
}>;
/** A music video drawn frame by frame from a decoded song, matching the live preview; for `exportCanvasVideo`. */
export function createMusicReactiveRenderer(audio: OfflineAudioSource, options?: MusicReactiveRendererOptions): MusicReactiveRenderer;
```

### `@optimai/creative-agents/beat-tracker`

Declared in `src/beat-tracker.d.mts`, implemented in `src/beat-tracker.mjs`.

```ts
export type BeatTrackerOptions = {
  /** AudioContext.sampleRate and AnalyserNode.fftSize. */
  sampleRate?: number; fftSize?: number;
  /** Tempo search range; maxBpm must be at least 1.25 × minBpm. */
  minBpm?: number; maxBpm?: number;
  /** Median-threshold multiplier, 1–4 (higher = fewer onsets). */
  sensitivity?: number;
  /** Tempo confidence (0–1) needed before the beat clock locks. */
  minConfidence?: number;
  /** WCAG 2.3.1 cap on visual pulses; clamped to at most 3. */
  maxFlashesPerSecond?: number;
  /** Pulse decay time constant in ms. */
  pulseMs?: number;
  /** Keep tempo and beats but turn the visual pulse off. */
  reducedMotion?: boolean;
};
export declare const BEAT_TRACKER_DEFAULTS: Readonly<{ minBpm: number; maxBpm: number; sensitivity: number; minConfidence: number; maxFlashesPerSecond: number; pulseMs: number }>;
export declare const BEAT_TRACKER_LIMITS: Readonly<{ bands: 24; maxFrequencyBins: 16384; thresholdMs: 1000; historyMs: 8000; maxOnsets: 64; minOnsetGapMs: 100 }>;
/** 24 log bands (30 Hz to 11 kHz), normalized 0–1; fills and returns `out` when given. */
export declare function logBandSpectrum(frequencyBytes: Uint8Array, options?: { sampleRate?: number; fftSize?: number }, out?: Float32Array): Float32Array;
/** Half-wave rectified mean rise per band, 0–1. */
export declare function spectralFlux(previous: ArrayLike<number>, current: ArrayLike<number>): number;
export type TempoEstimate = { bpm: number; periodMs: number; confidence: number };
/** Tempo from onset times in ms (inter-onset autocorrelation); bpm is 0 below four onsets. */
export declare function estimateTempo(onsetTimesMs: readonly number[], options?: { minBpm?: number; maxBpm?: number; weights?: readonly number[] }): TempoEstimate;
export type FlashLimiter = { allow(timeMs: number): boolean; reset(): void; readonly minGapMs: number };
/** WCAG 2.3.1: at most `maxFlashesPerSecond` (≤ 3) evenly spaced flashes per second. */
export declare function createFlashLimiter(options?: { maxFlashesPerSecond?: number }): FlashLimiter;
/** Reads `(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)`; false where matchMedia is absent. */
export declare function prefersReducedMotion(scope?: { matchMedia?(query: string): { matches: boolean } }): boolean;
export type BeatFrame = {
  time: number; flux: number; threshold: number;
  /** A new onset was detected in this frame; strength is 0–1. */
  onset: boolean; strength: number;
  /** 0 until the clock locks. */
  bpm: number; confidence: number; locked: boolean;
  /** A predicted beat fell in this frame; phase is 0 on a beat, rising to 1. */
  beat: boolean; beatCount: number; phase: number;
  /** Flash-limited beat (false with reduced motion) and its decaying 0–1 envelope. */
  flash: boolean; pulse: number;
};
export type BeatTracker = { push(frequencyBytes: Uint8Array, timeMs: number): BeatFrame; reset(): void; reducedMotion: boolean; readonly bpm: number };
export declare function createBeatTracker(options?: BeatTrackerOptions): BeatTracker;
```

```ts
export declare const SMART_CROP_LIMITS: Readonly<{ analysisEdge: 96; maxMapPixels: 262144; candidates: 97 }>;
```

### `@optimai/creative-agents/color`

Declared in `src/color.d.mts`, implemented in `src/color.mjs`.

```ts
export declare const COLOR_LIMITS: Readonly<{ analysisEdge: 64; maxPixels: 262144; maxColors: 12; maxSurfaces: 64; iterations: 10 }>;

/** A `#rgb` / `#rrggbb` string or an sRGB `[r, g, b]` array with 0–255 channels. */
export type ColorInput = string | [number, number, number] | number[];
/** One dominant color; weights in a palette sum to 1. */
export type PaletteSwatch = { color: string; weight: number; oklch: [number, number, number] };
/** Text color chosen by `pickLegibleColor`; `contrast` and `lightness` are the worst case over the backgrounds. */
export type LegibleColor = { color: string; contrast: number; lightness: number; passes: boolean; adjusted: boolean };

/** Parse `#rgb` or `#rrggbb` into `[r, g, b]`. */
export declare function parseHexColor(hex: string): [number, number, number];
/** Format a color (rounded and clamped) as `#rrggbb`. */
export declare function formatHexColor(color: ColorInput): string;
/** WCAG 2.x relative luminance, 0–1. */
export declare function relativeLuminance(color: ColorInput): number;
/** WCAG 2.x contrast ratio, 1–21. */
export declare function contrastRatio(a: ColorInput, b: ColorInput): number;
/** OKLab `[L, a, b]`. */
export declare function toOklab(color: ColorInput): [number, number, number];
/** OKLCH `[L, C, h]`, hue in degrees (0 for neutrals). */
export declare function toOklch(color: ColorInput): [number, number, number];
/** Hex for OKLab `[L, a, b]`, gamut-mapped by lowering chroma. */
export declare function fromOklab(lab: [number, number, number] | number[]): string;
/** Hex for OKLCH `[L, C, h]`, gamut-mapped by lowering chroma. */
export declare function fromOklch(lch: [number, number, number] | number[]): string;
/** Mix in OKLab; `amount` 0 returns `a`, 1 returns `b` (default 0.5). */
export declare function mixColors(a: ColorInput, b: ColorInput, amount?: number): string;
/** Polarity-aware OKLab lightness contrast, about −100 to +100; positive means darker text on a lighter background. Not APCA. */
export declare function lightnessContrast(text: ColorInput, background: ColorInput): number;
/** A text color that meets `minContrast` (WCAG, default 4.5) over every background, keeping a preferred color or only moving its lightness. */
export declare function pickLegibleColor(
    backgrounds: ColorInput | Array<ColorInput | { color: ColorInput }>,
    options?: { prefer?: ColorInput | Array<ColorInput | null | undefined>; minContrast?: number },
): LegibleColor;
/** Deterministic OKLab k-means palette of RGBA pixels, largest first. */
export declare function dominantColors(rgba: Uint8ClampedArray | Uint8Array, width: number, height: number, options?: { count?: number }): PaletteSwatch[];
/** The most vivid swatch that is also present, or null for a near-neutral palette. */
export declare function pickAccentColor(palette: Array<{ color: ColorInput; weight: number }>, options?: { minChroma?: number; minWeight?: number }): string | null;
/** Dominant colors of an image or a source-pixel `region` of it, read from a 64-pixel thumbnail; null when pixels cannot be read. */
export declare function analyzeImageColors(
    source: CanvasImageSource,
    sourceWidth: number,
    sourceHeight: number,
    options?: { region?: { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number }; count?: number },
): PaletteSwatch[] | null;
```

### `@optimai/creative-agents/color-grade`

Declared in `src/color-grade.d.mts`, implemented in `src/color-grade.mjs`.

```ts
export declare const GRADE_LIMITS: Readonly<{ pixels: 16000000; seed: 4294967295 }>;

/** Grade settings; every field is optional when passed to `resolveGrade`. Hues are degrees. */
export type GradeSettings = {
  /** Linear-light exposure in stops, −2 to 2 (0). */ exposure: number;
  /** S-curve on OKLab L pivoting on mid grey, −1 to 1 (0). */ contrast: number;
  /** Black lift, 0 to 0.3 (0). */ fade: number;
  /** Chroma scale, 0 (monochrome) to 2 (1). */ saturation: number;
  /** Chroma boost that favours muted colors, −1 to 1 (0). */ vibrance: number;
  /** Blue (−1) to yellow (1) along OKLab b, weighted by lightness (0). */ temperature: number;
  /** Green (−1) to magenta (1) along OKLab a, weighted by lightness (0). */ tint: number;
  /** Split-tone hue for shadows, 0–360. */ shadowHue: number;
  /** Split-tone chroma for shadows, 0 to 0.1 (0). */ shadowTint: number;
  /** Split-tone hue for highlights, 0–360. */ highlightHue: number;
  /** Split-tone chroma for highlights, 0 to 0.1 (0). */ highlightTint: number;
  /** Seeded luminance grain, 0 to 1 (0). */ grain: number;
};
export type GradePreset = 'original' | 'noir' | 'warm' | 'cool' | 'punchy';
/** A complete, frozen grade from `resolveGrade`. */
export type ResolvedGrade = Readonly<GradeSettings>;

/** The Image Finish looks at full intensity. */
export declare const GRADE_PRESETS: Readonly<Record<GradePreset, ResolvedGrade>>;
/** A validated grade from a preset or partial settings, scaled from the identity by `amount` (0–1, default 1); hues are kept. */
export declare function resolveGrade(grade?: GradePreset | Partial<GradeSettings>, amount?: number): ResolvedGrade;
/** True when the grade leaves every pixel unchanged. */
export declare function isIdentityGrade(grade: ResolvedGrade): boolean;
/**
 * Grade RGBA pixels in place (alpha kept) and return them. Deterministic for the same pixels, grade and seed;
 * `rows: [start, end)` grades one band with results identical to a single pass.
 */
export declare function gradePixels<T extends Uint8ClampedArray | Uint8Array>(rgba: T, width: number, height: number, grade?: GradePreset | Partial<GradeSettings> | ResolvedGrade, options?: { seed?: number; rows?: [number, number] }): T;
/** One `#rgb`/`#rrggbb` color through a grade (without grain), as `#rrggbb`. */
export declare function gradeColor(color: string, grade?: GradePreset | Partial<GradeSettings> | ResolvedGrade): string;
```

### `@optimai/creative-agents/lut`

Declared in `src/lut.d.mts`, implemented in `src/lut.mjs`.

```ts
export declare const LUT_LIMITS: Readonly<{ size: 65; bytes: 16777216; title: 200; pixels: 16000000 }>;

/** A 3D LUT: `size`³ RGB entries on encoded sRGB, red fastest, then green, then blue. */
export type CubeLut = Readonly<{
  title: string;
  size: number;
  domainMin: readonly [number, number, number];
  domainMax: readonly [number, number, number];
  table: Float32Array;
}>;
export type FilmLook = 'golden' | 'teal-amber' | 'matte';
/** A film look as data: channel gains, saturation around luma, split tone, S-curve contrast, lifted black and soft white. */
export type FilmLookSettings = Readonly<{
  title: string;
  gain: readonly [number, number, number];
  saturation: number;
  shadow: readonly [number, number, number];
  highlight: readonly [number, number, number];
  contrast: number;
  black: number;
  white: number;
}>;

/** The built-in film looks as data. */
export declare const FILM_LOOKS: Readonly<Record<FilmLook, FilmLookSettings>>;
/**
 * Parse `.cube` text strictly: 3D only, LUT_3D_SIZE 2–65 before the table, optional TITLE, DOMAIN_MIN/DOMAIN_MAX or
 * LUT_3D_INPUT_RANGE, `#` comments, exactly size³ rows; up to 16 MiB. Errors name the line.
 */
export declare function parseCubeLut(text: string): CubeLut;
/** Write a LUT as `.cube` text with six decimals. */
export declare function formatCubeLut(lut: CubeLut): string;
/** Bake a transform of encoded sRGB (0–1) into a LUT; `size` 2–65 (33). */
export declare function createLut(transform: (rgb: [number, number, number]) => [number, number, number] | number[], options?: { size?: number; title?: string }): CubeLut;
/**
 * Apply a LUT to RGBA pixels in place (alpha kept) with trilinear interpolation and return them. `amount` (0–1, default 1)
 * mixes from the original; `rows: [start, end)` applies one band with results identical to a single pass.
 */
export declare function applyLut<T extends Uint8ClampedArray | Uint8Array>(rgba: T, width: number, height: number, lut: CubeLut, options?: { amount?: number; rows?: [number, number] }): T;
/** One `#rgb`/`#rrggbb` color through a LUT, as `#rrggbb`. */
export declare function lutColor(color: string, lut: CubeLut, amount?: number): string;
/** A built-in film look baked into a shared 33³ LUT. */
export declare function filmLut(name: FilmLook): CubeLut;
```

### `@optimai/creative-agents/typeset`

Declared in `src/typeset.d.mts`, implemented in `src/typeset.mjs`.

```ts
export declare const TYPESET_LIMITS: Readonly<{ characters: 2000; size: 1000; lines: 200 }>;
/** `balance`: the minimum line count, every line as even as possible. `pretty`: paragraph style, no lone short last word. `greedy`: first fit. */
export type WrapMode = 'balance' | 'pretty' | 'greedy';
export declare const WRAP_MODES: readonly WrapMode[];
/** Width of `text` set at `fontSize`, in pixels, without letter spacing. Widths are assumed to scale with size. */
export type MeasureText = (text: string, fontSize: number) => number;
export type LineBreaks = { lines: string[]; /** Width of each line in pixels, tracking included. */ widths: number[] };
export type TitleLayout = LineBreaks & {
  fontSize: number;
  /** Baseline-to-baseline distance in pixels. */
  lineHeight: number;
  /** Letter spacing in pixels (for `context.letterSpacing`). */
  tracking: number;
  /** Widest line in pixels. */
  width: number;
  /** `lines.length × lineHeight`. */
  height: number;
  /** False when nothing from maxSize to minSize fits; the layout is then at minSize. */
  fits: boolean;
  /** True when a word wider than the measure had to be split between characters. */
  split: boolean;
};

/** Tracking (em) and leading (× size) for a display size: +0.01em / 1.25 at ≤16px easing to −0.02em / 1.08 at ≥128px. */
export declare function opticalSize(fontSize: number): { tracking: number; leading: number };
/** Break text into lines at one size. Hard `\n` breaks are kept; words wider than `width` split between characters. `tracking` is in em. */
export declare function breakLines(text: string, options: { measure: MeasureText; width: number; fontSize?: number; wrap?: WrapMode; tracking?: number }): LineBreaks;
/**
 * The largest size from `maxSize` down to `minSize` (default 1) at which `text` fits `width` × `height` in at most
 * `maxLines` lines, keeping words whole when any size allows it. Optical tracking and leading unless `tracking` (em)
 * or `leading` (× size) are given. `measure` is called once per word and character, at `maxSize`.
 */
export declare function fitTitle(text: string, options: { measure: MeasureText; width: number; maxSize: number; height?: number; minSize?: number; maxLines?: number; wrap?: WrapMode; leading?: number; tracking?: number }): TitleLayout;
/** A `measure` from a 2D context and a CSS font for a size; measures with `letterSpacing` reset to 0px. */
export declare function canvasMeasure(context: { font: string; measureText(text: string): { width: number }; letterSpacing?: string }, font: (fontSize: number) => string): MeasureText;
```

### `@optimai/creative-agents/text-placement`

Declared in `src/text-placement.d.mts`, implemented in `src/text-placement.mjs`.

```ts
import type { FocusMap } from './smart-crop.mjs';

/** `auto` moves a title to the calmest region; the others are fixed. */
export type TextPosition = 'auto' | 'top' | 'center' | 'bottom';
export declare const TEXT_POSITIONS: readonly TextPosition[];
export declare const PLACEMENT_LIMITS: Readonly<{ maxSteps: 33; maxOpacity: 0.85 }>;

export type Size = { width: number; height: number };
export type Rect = { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number };
export type TextPlacement = Rect & {
  /** The vertical third the block's centre is in. */
  position: 'top' | 'center' | 'bottom';
  /** Interest under the block (with its breathing room), relative to the image mean: 0 calm, 1 average. */
  interest: number;
  /** The same, at the home spot. */
  homeInterest: number;
  /** True when the block left its home spot. */
  moved: boolean;
};
/** Where an engine drew a title block, in output pixels, as reported by Poster Lab, Letter Pose and Title Frame. */
export type TitlePlacement = { position: 'top' | 'center' | 'bottom'; x: number; y: number; moved: boolean };
/** A scrim behind a title: a solid color at an opacity, drawn with `source-over`. */
export type TextScrim = { color: string; opacity: number };
export type FittedScrim = TextScrim & {
  /** Worst WCAG contrast of the ink over the scrimmed backgrounds. */
  contrast: number;
  passes: boolean;
  /** The backgrounds as seen through the scrim. */
  surfaces: string[];
};
type Background = string | [number, number, number] | { color: string };

/** Interest under a canvas-pixel region relative to the image mean (0 calm, 1 average); `canvas` is the size the map covers. */
export declare function regionInterest(focus: FocusMap, region: Rect, canvas: Size): number;
/**
 * Where to put a title block: the calmest spot inside `bounds` for `auto`, or a fixed `top`, `center` or `bottom`.
 * `home` ({ x, y }, 0–1 across the free space, default bottom-left) is the usual spot; `homeBias` (default 0.25)
 * is the cost of moving all the way across in units of average interest; the block moves only when at least `minGain`
 * (default 0.25) calmer. A missing or flat focus map stays home.
 */
export declare function placeTextBlock(
  focus: FocusMap | null,
  options: { canvas: Size; block: Size; bounds?: Rect; position?: TextPosition; home?: { x?: number; y?: number }; homeBias?: number; minGain?: number; columns?: number; rows?: number; breathing?: number },
): TextPlacement;
/** The lightest scrim (black behind light ink, white behind dark ink) that lifts `ink` to `minContrast` (default 3), or null when it already passes. */
export declare function fitScrim(backgrounds: Background | Background[], ink: string, options?: { minContrast?: number; minOpacity?: number; maxOpacity?: number; color?: string }): FittedScrim | null;
/**
 * Ink and optional scrim for a title: keep a passing preferred color, accept a lightness move of at most `maxShift`
 * (OKLab L, default 0.08), otherwise keep the first preferred color behind a scrim (`scrim: false` only moves lightness). Scrims are at least `minOpacity` (default 0.15).
 */
export declare function chooseTitleInk(
  surfaces: Background[],
  options?: { prefer?: Array<string | null | undefined>; minContrast?: number; scrim?: boolean; maxShift?: number; minOpacity?: number; maxOpacity?: number },
): { ink: string; scrim: TextScrim | null; surfaces: string[] };
```

```ts
export type GlitchEffect = 'blocks' | 'trails' | 'echoes';
export type GlitchTreatment = 'block displacement' | 'colour trails' | 'frame echoes';
export declare const GLITCH_EFFECTS: readonly GlitchEffect[];
/** Recipe treatment names (the Glitch Cut `effect` field) and the effect each one draws. */
export declare const GLITCH_TREATMENTS: Readonly<Record<GlitchTreatment, GlitchEffect>>;
export declare const GLITCH_LIMITS: Readonly<{ seed: 999999; pixels: 16000000 }>;
export type GlitchOptions = {
  /** An effect or a recipe treatment name. Default `blocks`. */
  effect?: GlitchEffect | GlitchTreatment;
  /** Strength, 0 (untouched) to 100. Default 35. */
  amount?: number;
  /** Whole number from 0 to 999999. Default 1. */
  seed?: number;
};
export type GlitchSettings = Readonly<{ effect: GlitchEffect; amount: number; seed: number }>;
export type GlitchBand = Readonly<{ y: number; height: number; shift: number }>;
export type GlitchBlock = Readonly<{ x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number; dx: number; dy: number }>;
export type GlitchEcho = Readonly<{ dx: number; dy: number; alpha: number }>;
/** The deterministic layout of one glitch at one size. */
export type GlitchPlan = Readonly<GlitchSettings & {
  width: number; height: number;
  bands: readonly GlitchBand[]; blocks: readonly GlitchBlock[]; echoes: readonly GlitchEcho[];
  /** Red leads and blue trails by this many pixels. */ split: number;
  /** 1, or 3 for a smeared colour trail. */ taps: 1 | 3;
  /** Every other `period / 2` rows are darkened by `depth / 256`. */ scanlines: Readonly<{ period: number; depth: number }>;
}>;
/** The mulberry32 generator: floats in [0, 1) from a 32-bit seed. */
export function mulberry32(seed: number): () => number;
/** A fresh seed (0–999999) for a new look. */
export function randomGlitchSeed(): number;
/** Validate glitch settings; recipe treatment names are accepted as aliases. */
export function resolveGlitch(options?: GlitchOptions): GlitchSettings;
/** The same seed, effect, amount and size always give the same plan. */
export function planGlitch(width: number, height: number, options?: GlitchOptions): GlitchPlan;
/** Glitch an RGBA buffer into `out` (which may be the input). Pass options or a plan made for this size. */
export function glitchPixels<T extends Uint8ClampedArray | Uint8Array = Uint8ClampedArray>(pixels: Uint8ClampedArray | Uint8Array, width: number, height: number, options?: GlitchOptions | GlitchPlan, out?: T): T;
```

```ts
export type PrintLook = 'riso' | 'halftone' | 'floyd-steinberg' | 'bayer' | 'blue-noise';
export type PrintStyle = 'riso duotone' | 'halftone dots' | 'error diffusion' | 'ordered dither' | 'blue-noise grain';

export declare const PRINT_STYLES: Readonly<Record<PrintStyle, PrintLook>>;

export type PrintOptions = {
  /** A look or a recipe style name. Default `riso`. */
  look?: PrintLook | PrintStyle;

  scale?: number;
  /** How much of the print covers the original, 0 (untouched) to 100. Default 100. */
  amount?: number;
  /** Moves the blue-noise grain and the riso misregistration; 0–999999. Default 1. */
  seed?: number;
  /** Midtone lightening before screening, 0 (linear tone) to 1: coverage becomes x·(1 − g) + x²·g. Default 0.45. */
  dotGain?: number;

  ink?: string;

};

export function resolvePrint(options?: PrintOptions): PrintSettings;

export function bayerMatrix(size?: 2 | 4 | 8 | 16): Uint16Array;
/** A tileable void-and-cluster blue-noise matrix (16, 32 or 64 wide): ranks 0 … size² − 1, row by row. A fresh copy each call. */
export function blueNoiseMatrix(size?: 16 | 32 | 64): Uint16Array;

export function printPixels<T extends Uint8ClampedArray | Uint8Array = Uint8ClampedArray>(pixels: Uint8ClampedArray | Uint8Array, width: number, height: number, options?: PrintOptions, out?: T): T;
```

```ts
import type { ToolTemplate } from './index.mjs';

export declare const AGENT_FORM_SCHEMA_VERSION: '1.0';
export type FormControl = 'text' | 'textarea' | 'select' | 'color' | 'slider' | 'stepper' | 'number' | 'seed';
/** `engine`: the on-device workspace reads it. `alias`: an older recipe name the engine maps when the canonical setting is missing. `brief`: shapes the prepared brief only. `unused`: neither (only possible for unreviewed templates). */
export type FormRole = 'engine' | 'alias' | 'brief' | 'unused';
export type FormGroupId = 'content' | 'look' | 'color' | 'layout' | 'motion';
export declare const FORM_CONTROLS: readonly FormControl[];
export declare const FORM_ROLES: readonly FormRole[];
export declare const FORM_GROUPS: readonly Readonly<{ id: FormGroupId; title: string }>[];
export type FormFieldHints = {
  control: FormControl;
  group: FormGroupId;
  /** Position in `x-ui.order`. */
  order: number;
  role: FormRole;
  /** Number controls only. */
  step?: number;
  /** Alias role only: the canonical setting it stands in for. */
  aliasOf?: string;
};
export type FormPropertySchema = {
  title: string;
  default: string | number;
  type: 'string' | 'integer';
  enum?: readonly string[];
  minimum?: number;
  maximum?: number;
  maxLength?: number;
  pattern?: string;
  description?: string;
  'x-ui': FormFieldHints;
};
export type AgentFormSchema = {
  $schema: 'https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema';
  $id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  type: 'object';
  additionalProperties: false;
  properties: Record<string, FormPropertySchema>;
  'x-ui': { version: '1.0'; groups: { id: FormGroupId; title: string; fields: string[] }[]; order: string[] };
  'x-optimai': { templateId: string; workspace: { kind: string; operation?: string }; contract: string };
};
export type FormField = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  control: FormControl;
  group: FormGroupId;
  role: FormRole;
  step?: number;
  aliasOf?: string;
  /** The property schema without `x-ui`. */
  schema: Omit<FormPropertySchema, 'x-ui'>;
};
/** The role each setting plays for a template's workspace. Accepts an id or a template object. */
export function getAgentFieldRoles(idOrTemplate: string | Pick<ToolTemplate, 'id' | 'fields' | 'workspace'>): Record<string, FormRole>;
/**
 * JSON Schema 2020-12 for a template's recipe `values`, with the bounds `validateRecipeValues` enforces and
 * `x-ui` hints per setting. Returns a fresh object; throws for an unknown id or an unsupported setting.
 */
export function getAgentFormSchema(idOrTemplate: string | Pick<ToolTemplate, 'id' | 'fields' | 'workspace'> & Partial<Pick<ToolTemplate, 'title' | 'description'>>): AgentFormSchema;
/** The schema's settings in display order, flattened for a form renderer. */
export function listFormFields(schema: AgentFormSchema): FormField[];
/** The schema without `x-ui`/`x-optimai` hints, for strict validators and tool definitions such as MCP `inputSchema`. */
export function plainFormSchema(schema: AgentFormSchema): Omit<AgentFormSchema, 'x-ui' | 'x-optimai' | 'properties'> & { properties: Record<string, Omit<FormPropertySchema, 'x-ui'>> };
```

```ts
export { createFlashLimiter, prefersReducedMotion } from './beat-tracker.mjs';

export declare const REDUCED_MOTION_QUERY: '(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)';

export declare const MOTION_PREFERENCES: readonly MotionPreferenceMode[];
export declare const FLASH_LIMITS: Readonly<{ maxFlashesPerSecond: 3; luminanceChange: number; darkerBelow: number; windowMs: number; samples: number; pixels: number }>;
export declare const ALT_TEXT_LIMIT: 300;

/** What a stage needs from a reduced-motion source; a real `MediaQueryList` also fits. */
export type MotionPreferenceLike = {
  readonly matches: boolean;
  addEventListener(type: 'change', listener: (event: { matches: boolean }) => void): void;
  removeEventListener(type: 'change', listener: (event: { matches: boolean }) => void): void;
};
export type MotionPreference = MotionPreferenceLike & {
  readonly media: '(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)';
  /** What the user chose in the app. */
  readonly preference: MotionPreferenceMode;
  /** What the device asks for, regardless of the override. */
  readonly system: boolean;
  set(preference: MotionPreferenceMode): void;
  dispose(): void;
};
/** A `MediaQueryList` look-alike for reduced motion with an in-app override. Safe without `matchMedia`. */
export function createMotionPreference(options?: { preference?: MotionPreferenceMode; scope?: { matchMedia?(query: string): unknown } }): MotionPreference;

export type AgentMotion = Readonly<{
  /** True when the agent animates on its own (turntable, orbit, visualizer, live effects). */
  moves: boolean;
  /** What reduced motion does: hold a calm cover, pause rotation, hold effects still, or nothing (`none`). */
  reduced: 'calm' | 'paused' | 'still' | 'none';
  /** One line a workspace can show; empty for still agents. */
  note: string;
}>;
export function getAgentMotion(id: string): AgentMotion;
/** The reduced-motion variant of an agent's settings. Fresh object; never adds keys a strict validator rejects. */
export function reducedMotionSettings<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(id: string, settings?: T): T & { rotating?: false; reducedMotion?: true; beatSync?: false; pulse?: 0 };

/** Mean WCAG relative luminance (0–1) of RGBA data, sampling at most 65,536 pixels. */
export function frameLuminance(data: ArrayLike<number>): number;
export type FlashSample = number | { time: number; luminance: number };
export type FlashReport = Readonly<{
  transitions: number;
  flashes: number;
  /** Most flashes in any one-second window. */
  maxFlashesPerSecond: number;
  worstAtMs: number | null;
  /** `maxFlashesPerSecond` is at most the limit (3 by default). Frame averages miss small-area and red flashes. */
  safe: boolean;
}>;
export function measureFlashes(samples: ArrayLike<FlashSample>, options?: { fps?: number; maxFlashesPerSecond?: number }): FlashReport;

/** "dark blue", "light grey", "white"… for a six-digit hex; empty for anything else. */
export function colorName(hex: string): string;
export type OutputDetails = {
  width?: number;
  height?: number;
  /** The title lines the engine actually drew. */
  lines?: string[];

  frames?: number;
  subject?: string;

};
```

### `@optimai/creative-agents/compare`

```ts
/** An RGBA image: `ImageData` or any `{ data, width, height }` with width × height × 4 bytes. */
export type CompareImage = { data: ArrayLike<number>; width: number; height: number };
export type CompareRect = Readonly<{ x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number }>;
export type CompareOptions = {
  /** Longest side of the sampled grid (16–2048, default 512). */
  maxSide?: number;
  /** A grid pixel counts as changed when its largest channel moves more than this (0–254, default 8). */
  threshold?: number;
  /** SSIM window size in grid pixels (2–32, default 8). */
  window?: number;
  /** Also return an RGBA heatmap of the change on the grid. */
  diff?: boolean;
};
export type Comparison = Readonly<{
  width: number; height: number; grid: Readonly<{ width: number; height: number }>;
  sameSize: boolean; identical: boolean; threshold: number;
  /** Share of grid pixels that changed (0–1). */
  changed: number;
  /** Mean and peak channel change (0–1). */
  meanDelta: number; maxDelta: number;
  /** Peak signal-to-noise ratio in dB; `Infinity` when identical. */
  psnr: number;
  /** SSIM-lite on luma (−1…1; 1 is the same structure). */
  ssim: number;
  /** Mean OKLab colour distance per pixel. */
  deltaE: number;
  /** The overall look on a ≤24-pixel grid, where grain, dither and dot patterns average out: mean OKLab shift and SSIM-lite. */
  overall: Readonly<{ deltaE: number; ssim: number }>;
  /** The changed region in `a`'s pixels, or null. */
  bounds: CompareRect | null;
  diff?: Readonly<{ data: Uint8ClampedArray; width: number; height: number }>;
}>;
export type SplitView = Readonly<{
  position: number; orientation: 'horizontal' | 'vertical';
  before: CompareRect; after: CompareRect;
  line: Readonly<{ x1: number; y1: number; x2: number; y2: number }>;
  /** CSS `inset()` that shows the `before` layer over a stacked `after` layer. */
  clipPath: string;
}>;
/** Anything `compareImages` can decode in a browser. */
export type ComparableSource = CompareImage | Blob | string | CanvasImageSource;
export declare const COMPARE_LIMITS: Readonly<{ maxSide: number; minSide: number; maxSampleSide: number; window: number; threshold: number; overallSide: number; maxInputPixels: number }>;
export declare function compareGrid(a: { width: number; height: number }, b: { width: number; height: number }, maxSide?: number): { width: number; height: number };
export declare function compareOutputs(a: CompareImage, b: CompareImage, options?: CompareOptions): Comparison;
export declare function describeComparison(result: Comparison | null | undefined): string;
export declare function splitView(position?: number, width?: number, height?: number, options?: { orientation?: 'horizontal' | 'vertical' }): SplitView;
export declare function stepSplit(position: number, key: string, options?: { step?: number }): number | undefined;
export declare function compareImages(a: ComparableSource, b: ComparableSource, options?: CompareOptions & { signal?: AbortSignal }): Promise<Comparison>;
```

```ts
  title: string;
  description: string;
  category: string;
  kind: 'canvas' | 'vision';

 * A raw control value read into one the schema accepts: numbers parsed, rounded and clamped (empty falls back to the
 * default), choices and malformed hex colors fall back, text is cut to its limit. `partial` keeps an unfinished hex while typing.
```

### `@optimai/creative-agents/run-record`

Declared in `src/run-record.d.mts`, implemented in `src/run-record.mjs`.

```ts
export declare const RUN_RECORD_VERSION: 1;
export declare const RUN_RECORD_LIMITS: Readonly<{ settings: 32768; output: 4096; depth: 8; inputs: 16; bytes: number; history: 100 }>;
type Json = string | number | boolean | null | readonly Json[] | { readonly [key: string]: Json };
/** `sha256:<64 hex>` with Web Crypto, otherwise `h64:<16 hex>`. */
export type InputsDigest = `sha256:${string}` | `h64:${string}`;
/** One agent result's provenance. `hash` covers the template, settings, seed, SDK version and inputs digest only. */
export type RunRecord = Readonly<{
  version: 1;
  /** 16 lowercase hex characters, stable across engines and key order. */
  hash: string;
  templateId: string;
  settings: Readonly<Record<string, Json>>;
  seed: number | null;
  sdkVersion: string | null;
  inputsDigest: InputsDigest | null;
  /** Not hashed. */ createdAt?: string;
  /** Not hashed; plain JSON such as `{ width, height, filename }`. */ output?: Readonly<Record<string, Json>>;
}>;
export type RunRecordInput = {
  templateId: string;
  settings?: Record<string, unknown>;
  sdkVersion?: string | null;
  /** Defaults to a whole-number `settings.seed`, else null. */
  seed?: number | null;
  inputsDigest?: InputsDigest | string | null;
  createdAt?: string;
  output?: Record<string, unknown>;
};
/** JSON with sorted keys, finite numbers only and −0 written as 0. */
export function canonicalJson(value: unknown): string;
/** A stable 64-bit hash of a string's UTF-8 bytes (16 hex characters). Not a security hash. */
export function hashText(text: string): string;
/** Digest selected inputs in order; only bytes count, never file names. */
export function digestInputs(inputs: Blob | ArrayBuffer | ArrayBufferView | string | readonly (Blob | ArrayBuffer | ArrayBufferView | string)[], options?: { signal?: AbortSignal; subtle?: SubtleCrypto | null }): Promise<InputsDigest>;
export function createRunRecord(input: RunRecordInput): RunRecord;
/** Read a stored or shared record; throws when it is malformed or its hash does not match. */
export function parseRunRecord(value: unknown): RunRecord;
export function verifyRunRecord(value: unknown): boolean;
/** Settings split into portable v1 recipe `values` and engine-only `extra` settings. */
export function runRecipeValues(templateId: string, settings?: Record<string, unknown>): { values: Record<string, string | number>; extra: Record<string, unknown> };
export type RunHistoryEntry<A = unknown> = Readonly<{ record: RunRecord; attachment: A; at: number }>;
export type RunHistory<A = unknown> = {
  /** Newest first. A repeated hash moves to the front; every `evicted` entry's attachment should be released. */
  add(record: RunRecord, attachment?: A): { entry: RunHistoryEntry<A>; added: boolean; evicted: RunHistoryEntry<A>[] };
  /** Keep the newest run even if another arrives within `settleMs`. */
  settle(): void;
  get(hash: string): RunHistoryEntry<A> | null;
  list(): RunHistoryEntry<A>[];
  readonly size: number;
  clear(): RunHistoryEntry<A>[];
};
/** `limit` 1–100 (default 12). With `settleMs`, a run made within that time of the previous one replaces it. */
export function createRunHistory<A = unknown>(options?: { limit?: number; settleMs?: number; now?: () => number }): RunHistory<A>;
```

### `@optimai/creative-agents/transition`

Declared in `src/transition.d.mts`, implemented in `src/transition.mjs`.

```ts
export type TransitionStyle = 'wipe' | 'radial' | 'luma' | 'push' | 'dissolve';
export type TransitionDirection = 'right' | 'left' | 'down' | 'up';
export type TransitionEase = 'linear' | 'in-out' | 'out';
export type TransitionPace = 'quick' | 'gentle' | 'slow cinematic';
export type TransitionTechnique = 'match cut' | 'camera move' | 'light wipe' | 'morph';
export declare const TRANSITION_STYLES: readonly TransitionStyle[];
export declare const TRANSITION_DIRECTIONS: readonly TransitionDirection[];
export declare const TRANSITION_EASES: readonly TransitionEase[];
/** Recipe pace names: how soft the moving edge is (a quick cut is nearly hard; a slow one melts). */
export declare const TRANSITION_PACES: Readonly<Record<TransitionPace, Readonly<{ ease: TransitionEase; softness: number }>>>;
/** Recipe technique names (the Transition Lab `transition` field) and the style each one draws. */
export declare const TRANSITION_TECHNIQUES: Readonly<Record<TransitionTechnique, TransitionStyle>>;
export declare const TRANSITION_LIMITS: Readonly<{ frames: 12; pixels: 16000000 }>;
export type TransitionOptions = {
  style?: TransitionStyle;
  /** Wipe and push travel; ignored by radial, luma and dissolve. Default `right`. */
  direction?: TransitionDirection;
  /** Supplies `ease` and `softness` unless they are given. Default `gentle`. */
  pace?: TransitionPace;
  ease?: TransitionEase;
  /** Feathered edge width, 0 (hard) to 1, in the matte's 0–1 units. */
  softness?: number;
  /** Radial iris centre, as fractions of width and height. Default `[0.5, 0.5]`. */
  center?: readonly [number, number];
};
export type TransitionSettings = Readonly<{ style: TransitionStyle; direction: TransitionDirection; ease: TransitionEase; softness: number; center: readonly [number, number] }>;
/** Validate and complete transition settings. */
export function resolveTransition(options?: TransitionOptions): TransitionSettings;
/** Eased progress for a time from 0 to 1 (clamped); `in-out` is smoothstep, `out` a cubic ease-out. */
export function transitionProgress(time: number, ease?: TransitionEase): number;
/** Default video clip: duration, frame rate and the share of the clip each still shot holds at both ends. */
export declare const TRANSITION_CLIP: Readonly<{ seconds: 2.4; fps: 30; hold: 0.15 }>;
/** Linear time (0–1) of video frame `frame` of `frames` (≥ 2), holding each shot for `hold` (0–0.45) at both ends; ease it with `transitionProgress`. */
export function transitionClipTime(frame: number, frames: number, options?: { hold?: number }): number;
/** `count` (2–12) evenly spaced times from 0 to 1 inclusive. */
export function transitionTimes(count: number): number[];
/** Compose one opaque frame of `from` → `to` at an eased progress into `out` (which may alias an input, except for push). */
export function composeTransition<T extends Uint8ClampedArray | Uint8Array = Uint8ClampedArray>(from: Uint8ClampedArray | Uint8Array, to: Uint8ClampedArray | Uint8Array, width: number, height: number, progress: number, options?: TransitionOptions, out?: T): T;
```

```ts
export declare const OFFLINE_ANALYSER_LIMITS: Readonly<{ maximumSeconds: number; maximumSampleRate: number; maximumChannels: number }>;
export declare const OFFLINE_ANALYSER_DEFAULTS: Readonly<{ fftSize: 2048; smoothingTimeConstant: 0.8; minDecibels: -100; maxDecibels: -30 }>;
/** Decoded audio: a Web Audio `AudioBuffer`, or plain channels with their sample rate. */
export type OfflineAudioSource = { sampleRate: number; numberOfChannels: number; length?: number; getChannelData(channel: number): Float32Array } | { sampleRate: number; channels: readonly Float32Array[] };
export type OfflineAnalyserOptions = {
  /** Power of two from 32 to 32,768. Default 2048, like `AnalyserNode`. */
  fftSize?: number;
  /** 0–1, like `AnalyserNode.smoothingTimeConstant`. Default 0.8; pass 0 when an elapsed-time smoother runs after it. */

  getFloatFrequencyData<T extends Float32Array>(out: T, seconds: number): T;
  /** Clear the smoothing history. */
  reset(): void;
}>;
/** In-place complex FFT (power-of-two length, forward, unscaled). */
export function fft<T extends Float64Array | Float32Array>(re: T, im: T): { re: T; im: T };

export function createOfflineAnalyser(audio: OfflineAudioSource, options?: OfflineAnalyserOptions): OfflineAnalyser;
```

```ts
import type { ProgressEvent } from './progress.mjs';
/**
 * Video export for canvas agents: probe the best local path, encode frame by frame with WebCodecs through the
 * optional `mediabunny` peer, or record in real time with MediaRecorder using the honest-recording helpers.
 */
export declare const VIDEO_EXPORT_LIMITS: Readonly<{ maximumSeconds: 300; maximumInputBytes: number; maximumOutputBytes: number; maximumSide: 4096; maximumFps: 120; setupTimeoutMs: 15000; seekTimeoutMs: 5000 }>;
export declare const RECORDER_VIDEO_TYPES: readonly string[];
export type VideoContainer = 'mp4' | 'webm';
/** mediabunny codec names the WebCodecs path uses. */
export type ExportVideoCodec = 'avc' | 'vp9' | 'vp8' | 'av1' | 'hevc';
export type ExportAudioCodec = 'aac' | 'opus';
export type VideoExportFormat = Readonly<{ container: VideoContainer; mime: string; extension: VideoContainer; video: readonly ExportVideoCodec[]; audio: readonly ExportAudioCodec[] }>;
export declare const VIDEO_EXPORT_FORMATS: Readonly<Record<VideoContainer, VideoExportFormat>>;
export type VideoExportErrorCode = 'setup-timeout' | 'source-unavailable' | 'source-too-large' | 'source-empty' | 'media-error' | 'media-timeout' | 'seek-error' | 'seek-timeout' | 'muxer-missing' | 'encoder-failed' | 'output-too-large' | 'recorder-missing' | 'recorder-failed' | 'audio-missing' | 'unsupported';
/** An export failure with a stable `code`; `message` is a plain English default a host may replace. */
export declare class VideoExportError extends Error {
  constructor(code: VideoExportErrorCode, message: string);
  readonly code: VideoExportErrorCode;
}
/** Injectable timers (for tests or hosts with their own clock). */
export type ExportTimers = { setTimeout: (callback: () => void, ms: number) => unknown; clearTimeout: (id: any) => void; /** Milliseconds clock used by the recorder's frame pacing; default `performance.now`. */ now?: () => number };

export declare function chooseRecorderType(supports: (mime: string) => boolean, options?: { audio?: boolean; container?: VideoContainer }): string | null;
export declare function checkExportDuration(seconds: number, options?: { maximumSeconds?: number }): null | 'unreadable' | 'too-long';
export declare function exportFrameCount(seconds: number, fps?: number): number;
export declare function videoExtension(mime: string): VideoContainer;
export declare function videoExportFilename(title: string, mime: string, options?: { fallback?: string; suffix?: string }): string;
export declare function waitForExportSetup<T>(start: () => T | PromiseLike<T>, options?: { signal?: AbortSignal; timeoutMs?: number; message?: string; timers?: ExportTimers }): Promise<T>;
export declare function readMediaForExport(source: string | Response, options?: { signal?: AbortSignal; maxBytes?: number; fetch?: typeof fetch; type?: string }): Promise<Blob>;
/** The parts of an `HTMLMediaElement` the wait helpers touch. */
export type ExportMedia = Pick<EventTarget, 'addEventListener' | 'removeEventListener'> & { readyState?: number; currentTime: number; seeking?: boolean; preload?: string; load?: () => void };
export declare function waitMediaReady(media: ExportMedia, options?: { signal?: AbortSignal; timeoutMs?: number; timers?: ExportTimers }): Promise<void>;
export declare function rewindMedia(media: ExportMedia, options?: { signal?: AbortSignal; timeoutMs?: number; timers?: ExportTimers }): Promise<void>;
export declare function saveBlob(blob: Blob, filename: string, options?: { document?: Document; URL?: { createObjectURL(blob: Blob): string; revokeObjectURL(url: string): void }; revokeAfterMs?: number; timers?: ExportTimers }): void;

/** The subset of the `mediabunny` module the SDK uses; pass the module itself (`await import('mediabunny')`). */
export type MediabunnyLike = {
  Output: new (options: { format: unknown; target: unknown }) => { state: string; target: { buffer: ArrayBuffer | null }; addVideoTrack(source: unknown, metadata?: { frameRate?: number }): unknown; addAudioTrack(source: unknown): unknown; start(): Promise<void>; finalize(): Promise<void>; cancel(): Promise<void> };
  BufferTarget: new () => unknown;
  Mp4OutputFormat: new () => unknown;
  WebMOutputFormat: new () => unknown;
  CanvasSource: new (canvas: HTMLCanvasElement | OffscreenCanvas, config: { codec: string; bitrate?: unknown; keyFrameInterval?: number }) => { add(timestamp: number, duration?: number): Promise<void> };
  AudioBufferSource?: new (config: { codec: string; bitrate?: unknown }) => { add(buffer: AudioBuffer): Promise<void> };
  canEncodeVideo?: (codec: any, options?: object) => Promise<boolean>;
  canEncodeAudio?: (codec: any, options?: object) => Promise<boolean>;
};
export type VideoExportPlan = Readonly<{
  engine: 'webcodecs' | 'recorder' | 'none';
  container: VideoContainer | null; mime: string | null; extension: VideoContainer | null;
  videoCodec: ExportVideoCodec | null; audioCodec: ExportAudioCodec | null;
  /** The real-time MediaRecorder fallback, even when WebCodecs wins. */
  recorderType: string | null;
  /** Why WebCodecs was not chosen, else null. */
  reason: null | 'muxer-missing' | 'webcodecs-missing' | 'codec-missing';
}>;
export declare function probeVideoExport(options?: { width?: number; height?: number; fps?: number; audio?: boolean; format?: 'auto' | VideoContainer; bitrate?: number; mediabunny?: MediabunnyLike | null; env?: object }): Promise<VideoExportPlan>;
export type EncodedVideo = Readonly<{ engine: 'webcodecs'; blob: Blob; mime: string; container: VideoContainer; extension: VideoContainer; videoCodec: ExportVideoCodec; audioCodec: ExportAudioCodec | null; frames: number; fps: number; duration: number; bytes: number }>;
export declare function encodeCanvasVideo(options: {
  mediabunny: MediabunnyLike;
  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement | OffscreenCanvas;
  /** Draw frame N at `seconds` onto the canvas. */
  render: (frame: number, seconds: number) => void | Promise<void>;
  frames: number;
  fps?: number;
  audio?: AudioBuffer | null;
  format?: VideoContainer;
  videoCodec?: ExportVideoCodec;
  audioCodec?: ExportAudioCodec;
  bitrate?: number;
  audioBitrate?: number;
  keyFrameSeconds?: number;
  signal?: AbortSignal;
  onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void;
  maxBytes?: number;
}): Promise<EncodedVideo>;
export type RecordedVideo = Readonly<{ engine: 'recorder'; blob: Blob; mime: string; container: VideoContainer; extension: VideoContainer; videoCodec: null; audioCodec: null; frames: number; fps: number; duration: number; bytes: number }>;
export type CanvasVideoOptions = {
  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement;
  /** Draw frame N at `seconds` onto the canvas. */
  render: (frame: number, seconds: number) => void | Promise<void>;
  frames: number;
  fps?: number;
  /** Soundtrack laid from 0 s. */
  audio?: AudioBuffer | null;
  bitrate?: number;
  signal?: AbortSignal;
  onProgress?: (event: ProgressEvent) => void;
  maxBytes?: number;
};
/** Real-time MediaRecorder fallback with the same render contract; the tab must stay visible. */
export declare function recordCanvasVideo(options: CanvasVideoOptions & {
  /** Recorder MIME type; default the best `chooseRecorderType` result. */
  mimeType?: string;
  /** Live audio tracks to record alongside (instead of, or as well as, `audio`). */
  audioTracks?: MediaStreamTrack[];
  env?: object;
  timers?: ExportTimers;
}): Promise<RecordedVideo>;
/** Export on the path `probeVideoExport` chose; a mid-way WebCodecs failure restarts once on the recorder unless `fallback` is false. */
export declare function exportCanvasVideo(options: CanvasVideoOptions & {
  probe: VideoExportPlan;
  mediabunny?: MediabunnyLike | null;
  fallback?: boolean;
  audioBitrate?: number;
  keyFrameSeconds?: number;
  env?: object;
  timers?: ExportTimers;
}): Promise<EncodedVideo | RecordedVideo>;
```

### `@optimai/creative-agents/verify`

Declared in `src/verify.d.mts`, implemented in `src/verify.mjs`.

```ts
export declare const VERIFY_LIMITS: Readonly<{ maxPixels: 262144; maxBoxes: 64; maxEvents: 4096; maxPalette: 32 }>;

/** An sRGB color as `[r, g, b]`, each 0–255. */
export type RGB = [number, number, number] | number[];
/** A region as fractions (0–1) of the frame. */
export type Box = { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number };
/** A focus map from smart-crop's `computeFocusMap` or `analyzeImageFocus`. */
export type FocusMap = { map: Float32Array; width: number; height: number };

/**
 * One deterministic check. Higher scores are better; `pass` means `score >= threshold`.
 * `confidence` (0.5–1) is a margin from the threshold, not a calibrated probability.
 */
export type CheckResult = {
    check: 'text-contrast' | 'text-size' | 'text-overlap' | 'safe-zone' | 'aspect' | 'duration' | 'count' | 'palette' | 'cut-alignment';
    pass: boolean;
    score: number;
    threshold: number;
    confidence: number;
    costMs: number;
};

/** WCAG 2.x relative luminance, 0–1. */
export declare function relativeLuminance(color: RGB): number;
/** WCAG contrast ratio, 1–21. */
export declare function contrastRatio(a: RGB, b: RGB): number;
/** OKLab `[L, a, b]` of an sRGB color. */
export declare function srgbToOklab(color: RGB): [number, number, number];
/** Euclidean OKLab distance (about 0.02 is just noticeable). */
export declare function deltaEOK(a: RGB, b: RGB): number;

/** Low-percentile WCAG contrast of known-color text over the pixels inside `box`. */
export declare function checkTextContrast(
    pixels: Uint8ClampedArray | Uint8Array,
    width: number,
    height: number,
    box: Box,
    textColor: RGB,
    options?: { minRatio?: number; percentile?: number },
): CheckResult;
/** Rendered text height in pixels against a minimum. */
export declare function checkTextSize(heightPx: number, options?: { minPx?: number }): CheckResult;
/** Share of visual interest left uncovered by text boxes (1 minus the covered share). */
export declare function checkTextOverlap(focus: FocusMap, boxes: Box[], options?: { maxShare?: number }): CheckResult;
```
